jobs.description:
It's a good feeling to know you're doing your best with purpose every day. At Artivion, we manufacture high-quality products and solutions for the treatment of aortic diseases. Together with surgeons worldwide, we save lives. In doing so, we rely on the strengths of each and every employee. Your strength counts, too: As an important link in the chain, you make a contribution to saving lives together with us. Contribute your strengths and let us grow together.

We are hiring a

Training & Education Specialist (m/f/d) – Europe based

Your Strength

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Medical Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) 
- Experience as a Clinical Specialist, Training & Education Specialist, Product Specialist, or within the aortic repair/endovascular field 
- Experience delivering technical and clinical product training 
- Knowledge of endovascular therapies, anatomy, and pathology 
- Experience developing training materials, educational programs, and e-learning content 
- Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms 
- Excellent presentation, coaching, and facilitation skills 
- Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills 
- Customer-focused mindset with the ability to collaborate across international, cross-functional teams 

Your Contribution

- Develop, deliver, and continuously improve Training & Education programs across the EMEA region 
- Plan and conduct internal and external product training, certification, and onboarding activities 
- Create and maintain training materials, e-learning modules, and educational documentation 
- Manage assigned learning content and support the administration of the Learning Management System (LMS) 
- Coordinate onboarding, reinforcement, and recertification programs 
- Support customer workshops and educational events across EMEA 
- Manage training equipment and educational resources to ensure training readiness 
- Evaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvements 
- Collaborate closely with Product Management, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Marketing, and Sales 
- Act as the subject matter expert for assigned Training & Education programs 

Our Strength

- An international team with a strong focus on quality, innovation, and collaboration 
- A dynamic role with exposure to colleagues and customers across the EMEA region 
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities 
- The opportunity to shape and improve training programs that directly support customer success 
- A meaningful career with a clear mission: saving lives 

Contact

Apply now and join the Artivion team. We are looking forward to receiving your application documents in English directly via our online system.

Brian Russo, T: +41 435 08 39 01
JOTEC GmbH, a wholly owned subsidiary of Artivion, Inc.,
Lotzenäcker 23, 72379 Hechingen
www.artivion.com (http://www.artivion.com/)

What to Expect

At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively, and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions.This is an opportunity to support key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities to create technologies that shape how energy systems evolve. You get to work on advancing power electronics used for Tesla products globally, thereby directly contributing to the acceleration of the world's transition to sustainable energy.

What You’ll Do

- Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage, run-out reports, and other analyses as needed to plan engineering builds
- Collaborate with suppliers during design meetings to monitor designed components, evaluate their complexity, and ensure supply chain considerations are addressed early
- Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues, and resolution
- Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (procurement, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.)
- Drive commercial cost negotiations with suppliers to ensure Tesla receives the best possible pricing and leverage cost models and analysis of current market conditions
- Monitor current market conditions and technology roadmaps to proactively identify and address any supply challenges and to determine future business opportunities
- Document component cost and work with Finance to track BOM cost in different program phases

What You’ll Bring

- At least 2 years’ experience in material sourcing, manufacturing, finance, or supply chain management
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in supply chain, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or similar discipline
- Knowledge of Material Requirements Planning / Enterprise Resource Planning ( MRP/ERP) with a solid understanding of discrete prototype manufacturing, bills of material, product lifecycle management, procure to pay processes and supply chain operations
- Proven experience in the management of high volume engineering builds
- Demonstrated understanding of product release cycle as it relates to the creation and change management of parts and BOM structures
- Ability to prioritize with a high sense of urgency, adapt to a fast-paced/dynamic environment, and act as a self-starter with strong attention to detail and ownership
- Business level fluency in English, German language skills are a plus

Mission

As a Financial Controller/Accountant at AES you’re accountable for collecting, analyzing and reporting financial data. In the role you propose solutions, cost reductions and optimization of processes. Your profile requires in depth understanding of finance, tax and accounting principles (HGB and IFRS).

Accounting/Tax

- Manage accounting books and financial statements under HGB/IFRS with the support of the accountant
- Organize close and schedules, manage accruals and provisions
- Responsible for analytical accounting
- Prepare and organize the yearly audit with support of the accountant
- Ensure tax compliance, manage tax audits with the support of the accountant/tax advisor
- Prepare and analyze internal and external mandatory reports
- Back-up accountant for various tasks ensuring business continuity (i.e. payments execution)

Controlling/Reporting

- Develop financial and operating KPIs and ad-hoc financial analysis to drive better decision-making and monitoring
- Prepare reporting packages and dashboards to track performance (company/project/cost center) and compliance, including variance analysis and executive commentary
- Organize and consolidate budget and forecasts, including long term projections and cash forecasts, reviews data and proposes cost reductions
- Provide ad-hoc financial modelling, business case calculations, financial analysis and reporting

Process and Tools

- Draw up, develop and update the accounting and finance process and guidelines, propose process improvements
- Support internal controls and various audit activities
- Key user ERP and Business intelligence tool, maintenance of the general ledger

Profile

- Degree in economics with a specialization in Controlling/Accounting (or equivalent knowledge and skills acquired by other means)
- Several years (more than 7 years) of professional experience in accounting and controlling (analysis, budgeting and financial controls)
- Advanced Skills in ERP system (ProAlpha, SAP FI-CO or similar) and AI / business intelligence tools (Qlik) skills
- Microsoft Excel skills on an expert level (ability to develop Excel macros)
- Experience with working in an international environment
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate/present effectively with all levels of company personnel,
- Flexibility (willingness to take on new responsibilities and assignments as needed) and ability to work under pressure
- Careful, diligent, and detail-oriented approach to work
- Excellent German and English language skills (English working language)
- Strong organizational skills combined with a proactive mindset, reliability, and a results-driven approach

jobs.occupation: Test Automation Engineer (f/m/d) at an established IT-Security Company (Testingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Zertificon Solutions – Software Manufacturer since 2004.
We are IT security specialists: our products encrypt business communications. More than 25% of the 100 highest-revenue companies in Germany, as well as hundreds of medium-sized enterprises across all industries, already use our Z1 encryption solutions. We have big plans and continue to grow steadily. Nearly 120 employees are already working with us in Neukölln. Join our professional, highly qualified team: take on challenges, share your knowledge, learn new things, and discover your potential!

Test Automation Engineer (f/m/d) at an established IT-Security Company 

Join us as a Test Automation Engineer — ready to grow, get hands-on with real-world security software, and help make sure every release is as solid as it can be. You don’t have to know everything (yet) — but you should be curious, reliable, and not afraid to break things in the name of better quality. You'll be joining our Enterprise Team, which focuses on the needs of our large corporate clients - particularly when it comes to customized solutions and cryptographic applications. Help us to change our Z1 products to meet the needs of our enterprise customers.

Develop and test

- Design, develop, and execute automated software tests
- Analyze test results and debug issues found by automated tests
- Conduct manual tests when automated testing is deemed excessive

Collaborate and support

- Collaborate closely with developers to understand system requirements, functional specifications, strategies, and solutions
- Identify, report, and track defects, working closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution
- Support the team in analyzing bugs in CI/CD pipelines

Document and improve

- Generate test reports, metrics, and documentation to communicate test results and status to project stakeholders
- Stay updated on the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance

Your profile

- Proven experience as a Test Automation Engineer of at least 3 years
- Competent in Selenium and Java programming language
- Skilled in testing web and backend services effectively
- Knowledgeable in Agile software development methodologies
- Familiar in Git for version control
- Familiar with Linux and shell scripting
- Experience with Docker for containerization
- Familiar with Gradle build tools
- Excellent English language skills, at least C1 level

Nice to have:

- Familiarity with tools like TestRail, JIRA, Confluence
- Experience with cryptographic concepts and its basic principles
- Working with Smart Cards/Hardware Security Modules or Key Vault services
- Understanding of Email protocols and RFCs like SMTP, MIME, S/MIME, OpenPGP 
- Good German language skills

We offer:

- Flexible hours and home office options
- Mobility: free Germany-wide public transport ticket, bike leasing, or parking
- Subsidies for meals (e.g., delivery services) and home office internet
- Urban Sports Club membership for flexible fitness and wellness
- Office perks: rooftop terraces & green courtyard, organic fruit and drinks, personal packages accepted at the office
- Get-togethers monthly Pizza Friday, regular team events, big summer party
- Responsible leadership: structured onboarding, regular feedback, clear goals
- Innovative without startup risk: profitable for 20+ years, self-funded innovation with strong global potential
- International team: 120+ colleagues from 30+ countries, open and collaborative culture

If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Want to know more? Please have a look at our Work at Zertificon page: https://www.zertificon.com/en/it-jobs-berlin/work-at-zertificon (https://www.zertificon.com/en/it-jobs-berlin/work-at-zertificon)

Questions?

You can reach our HR team at

jobs@zertificon.com (https://mailto:jobs@zertificon.com)

jobs.description:
What to Expect

What To ExpectYou will be an integral part of the Materials Engineering organization,
delivering new materials and manufacturing processes that revolutionize Tesla's
products to build a world of amazing abundance. As a Materials Engineer, you
will support the design, validation and implementation of new thermoplastic and
composite materials. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you'll enable
validation, resolve critical issues, and push continuous improvement forward.
This is a 1-year fixed-term contract at Tesla Engineering Germany GmbH and based

- Develop and prototype new thermoplastic and composite materials and processing strategies to enable future vehicle designs with lower manufacturing costs and improved quality.

- Develop or edit specifications and test procedures to define procurement and manufacturing quality standards, including acceptance criteria.
- Support different stakeholders to drive issue resolution.

What You’ll Bring

- Education in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or related field.
- 2+ years’ work experience as a materials engineer or related role.
- Understanding of process-structure-property relationships in polymers and their relevant manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, compression molding, extrusion, thermoforming). Familiarity with material modeling or simulation tools (e.g. Moldflow, Sigmasoft, LS-Dyna, ANSYS) is a plus.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience in materials characterization and testing with the ability to assess accuracy and limitations is a must. Experience with thermoplastics processing tools (injection molding, thermoforming, etc.) is a plus.
- Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities, organize workload, meet deadlines, and manage time independently.

Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The Senior Expert, SAP Lead - IT Applications & IT Platforms (m/f/d) is accountable for the end-to-end SAP ecosystem, ensuring continuity of the S/4HANA program, stability of operations, and alignment with business objectives. The role owns the SAP roadmap, core S/4HANA template, and governance framework across all SAP-related activities.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Own and drive the SAP strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities and transformation objectives
- Ensure continuity of the end-to-end SAP program across implementation, rollout, and operations
- Lead and govern the global SAP (S/4HANA) template + SAP cloud ecosystem, ensuring standardization, integrity, and controlled deviations
- Provide functional leadership to SAP IT teams leads, ensuring alignment across domains and E2E processes
- Manage SAP licensing, vendor ecosystem, and strategic partners, including performance, cost, and risk control

Show your expertise

- 10+ years of experience leading global SAP S/4HANA landscapes, transformation initiatives, and rollout programs
- Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA architecture, governance, template management, and integration landscapes
- Proven leadership experience in matrix organizations with strong stakeholder management and executive-level communication skills
- Solid knowledge of IT governance, compliance, security, audit requirements, and end-to-end traceability
- Experience in vendor, service, and contract management (SAP, AMS), including budget ownership and cost optimization
- University degree in Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a related field; MBA is an advantage
- SAP and project management certifications (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, ITIL, COBIT, PM methodologies) preferred; fluent English required, German is a strong advantage

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

We leverage these tools to continually enhance the performance of our company and our people, while driving results for our customers and users.Exciting environment for professional development - strong support for your professional development, backed-up by a feedback culture to help you identify your strengths and opportunities.Diversity - proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we aim to enable everyone to show up as their full selves. Everyday.”As part of the Axel Springer Group, we also align with the Axel Springer Essentials.If you think you could fit the bill, we'd love to hear from you!You can check out our bonial_people Instagram or read more about bonial culture and tech on Medium.

jobs.occupation: Systems & Electrical Engineer - Human Spaceflight & Microgravity (m/f/d) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Support proposal activities as well as the preparation of programmatic and technical documentation
- Translate scientific requirements into research instruments and facilities in close collaboration with scientific partners and space agencies
- Contribute to multiple engineering aspects of the projects, including the development of electrical architectures and related subsystem designs
- Perform requirements analysis, design, verification, and AIT (Assembly, Integration and Test) activities
- Support manufacturing, assembly, and test campaigns, including hands-on work with spaceflight hardware
- Contribute to mission support activities such as mission preparation, live operations support from the Ground Control Station, anomaly investigation and recovery, as well as post-processing of mission data
- Depending on the mission profile and destination (e.g. sounding rockets, ISS, free-flyers, or future space stations), support launch site activities and participate in mission-style campaign operations, including travel as required
Your Qualifications

- Degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification
- Experience in PCB development
- Good understanding of Linux-based operating systems as well as software source code in C and Python
- Initial project engineering experience, ideally in the space sector or another process-driven industry such as automotive
- Excellent communication skills in English and German

Your Profile

- You are a generalist with broad technical curiosity rather than a narrow specialist
- You are open to new challenges and enjoy working across disciplines
- You thrive in a role that combines organizational, technical, and analytical work
- You are comfortable operating in a structured engineering environment while maintaining flexibility and hands-on engagement

What to Expect

The expansion of Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg marks another defining moment in Europe for Tesla’s mission of accelerating the world’s transition to sustainable energy. Deploying extraordinary speed, innovation, and efficiency in manufacturing. To achieve these goals and help us write the next chapter of our success story, we're looking for exceptional talent to enter this journey together.As a Recruiter, you will get the opportunity to support the hiring ramp-up for one the largest high-tech manufacturing facilities in Europe, contribute with your creative ideas to impactful projects, and be part of an awesome team!

What You’ll Do

- Partnering with Hiring Managers to assess talent needs and provide expertise and guidance around hiring plan and strategy, driving the full end-to-end recruiting cycle
- Actively using data to shape how you work by knowing how to assess and measure your candidate funnels as well as preparing reporting for your hiring teams
- Working cross-functionally with different Talent Acquisition and People teams in your region and EMEA
- Focusing on providing a Best in Class candidate experience at every opportunity
- Conducting thorough behavioral-based interviews and phone screens to assess both technical ablity as well as skills necessary to be successful in the Tesla environment
- Advocating for and driving a diverse and inclusive recruitment strategy
- Sourcing passive candidates through various channels and activities

What You’ll Bring

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
- Previous recruiting experience in an agency and/or corporate environment, preferably recruiting for skilled blue collar roles such as mechanics or production workers or engineers
- A demonstrated track record of excellence in sourcing, assessing, and hiring talent 
- Proven relationship management experience with hiring teams and business partners, taking lead on assessing talent needs and setting hiring plans
- Proficient with creating reports by leveraging Excel and the ability to adopt and adapt quickly to new technology and systems (digitally savvy)
- Experience with working in an agile, fast-paced environment where things change very quickly, as well as the ability to adapt to constantly changing/fluctuating targets and business needs
- Skills in offer negotiation, awareness of pertinent employment legislation, and employment market trends
- Candidates are expected to uphold and actively promote sustainability principles in their daily work, operating in line with Tesla Global Environmental, Health, Safety & Security (EHS&S) Policy and EMAS requirements, fostering a culture of continuous environmental improvement.What We OfferYou will be working in our state-of-the-art Gigafactory, where you’ll solve the world's most interesting problems with the best and brightest people who share a passion for changing the world. Tesla’s compensation package includes a competitive salary and Tesla shares or bonuses. Typical benefits that are offered are a pension programme, 30 vacation days, flexible work arrangements, employee insurances, relocation, and commuting support.

What to Expect

Tesla Energy is
deploying the world’s largest fleet of battery energy storage systems (BESS)
from residential Powerwall to grid-scale Megapack, across dozens of markets
worldwide. Regulatory safety certification is the gate between engineering and
the market.

As a Regulatory Safety
Engineer you will be the in-house expert on product safety standards and
market-entry regulations for BESS and supporting power electronics. You will
translate complex normative requirements such as IEC, UL, CSA, EN, and beyond
into engineering design specifications, then drive products through
certification from first design review to certificate issue. You will work
alongside hardware, power electronics, firmware, and systems engineers, making
compliance a design and integral part of the process.

What You’ll Do

- Research and maintain a living map of market-entry requirements for BESS and ancillary equipment across North America, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets; interpret and apply applicable codes, regulations, and directives. 
- Horizon-scan for new and evolving standards affecting BESS products and communicate regulatory risk to engineering and programme leadership. 
- Develop Compliance Product Design Requirements (CPDRs) translating normative requirements into unambiguous engineering specifications, covering product-specific standards (IEC 62619, IEC 62933 series, IEC 62109/62477 series, UL 9540/9540A, UL 1741, UL 1973), and fundamental safety principles such as IEC 60664 series insulation coordination, IEC 60990 touch current, and IEC 60529 IP ratings. 
- Lead design reviews to identify compliance gaps and safety risks early; propose and track engineering solutions to closure. 
- Own CE marking end-to-end: conformity assessment route selection, technical file compilation, Declaration of Conformity (DoC) drafting, and Notified Body or competent authority liaison. 
- Define and manage certification strategies across global schemes such as UL/cUL (NRTL), CB Scheme (IECEE), CE marking, AS/NZS, and others as markets are entered, and author test plans and lead testing in-house and at accredited third-party laboratories. 
- Debug certification failures, root-cause anomalies, and propose design and/or test-method solutions; review test reports and manage certificate lifecycles, surveillance audits, and re-certification triggered by engineering changes. 
- Act as the regulatory safety SME for cross-functional engineering teams; support field compliance escalations and post-market surveillance; build internal knowledge bases and mentor junior engineers on regulatory processes and certification strategy. 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent; 5+ years in product safety certification for power electronics or energy storage products. 
- Proven CE marking expertise: technical file construction, DoC preparation, and Notified Body liaison; hands-on BESS and power electronics certification experience across IEC and UL standards (IEC 62619, 62933, 62109/62477, UL 9540, UL 1741, UL 1973). 
- Strong ability to interpret complex normative text, resolve ambiguities with laboratories and regulators, and translate requirements into testable engineering specifications. 
- Practical lab experience with power analysers, oscilloscopes, insulation testers, and environmental test chambers; clear written and verbal communication in English.

jobs.occupation: Staff Mechanical Design Engineer – Cabin Engineering  (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Cabin Engineering team leads concept development and launch of nearly all customer-facing areas inside our vehicles including Seats (all rows Structures, Support Systems, Comfort/Mechatronics) and Interiors (Cockpit (Instrument Panel, Door Trim, Console) and Cabin (Overhead Trims, Hard Trims, and Soft Trims)) through a vehicle’s end-of-life.  Our team’s goal is to innovate and engineer a premium Interior System for our vehicles while optimizing our critical attributes like cost, mass, manufacturability, etc. This is a pivotal role to act as liaison between US and Berlin engineering teams to tackle challenging problems together. As part of a global company, you will tackle engineering challenges together with US and CN Cabin teams alongside other cross-functional teams to continuously innovate and launch new products for Europe and other growing markets. 

What You’ll Do

- Lead a commodity group of the team (Seats, Cabin, or Cockpit) including scope of several subsystems through full engineering development and launch lifecycles, ensuring technical deliverables and timelines are met according to Program Plan of Record scope 
- Support technical development of the team via Technical Design Reviews, engineering training, and mentorship of more junior engineers 
- Design development, validation and manufacturing launch of components balancing inputs and attributes including, but not limited to, Design Studio styling, ergonomics, serviceability, integration packaging with cost, mass, craftsmanship, NVH, automation, etc. This iterative process includes close collaboration with Studio, Purchasing and Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and broader engineering teams through CAD development, CAE loops, RFQ stages, sourcing, part production, launch and build root-causing 
- Utilize and/or create DFSS, DFMEA, DVP&R concepts and processes to produce robust vehicle component designs alongside hands-on prototyping and trials to learn and fail fast. Consider both analytical and physical assessments including dimensional tolerance stack-ups in design as well as to create detailed GD&T drawings and corresponding checking fixtures. Work closely with Validation and Test & Reliability groups. Collaborate efficiently with key external suppliers and to support overall vehicle development milestones, prototype/production build events, and a successful start of production. Work in partnership with suppliers through part design (when applicable), root-cause troubleshooting, manufacturing trials, part and system level validation, etc. to actively understand and contribute to design solutions. 
- Analyze Field Reliability data of current programs to improve Interior Reliability through design/process/manufacturing changes. Release design changes through Tesla’s 3DExperience system to properly document and track part updates, MBOM changes, and PO releases to downstream teams and suppliers 
- Support team growth via hiring at all engineering levels for Cabin Engineering team.

What You’ll Bring

- Education background in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in automotive seats and/or interior component and subsystem engineering. Proficient in English. 
- First principles, physics-based thinker, and problem solver attitude with mental agility to handle problems of varied scope and complexity, and tight timing constraints. Demonstrate engineering technical aptitude, excellent communication, and creativity. 
- In-depth technical understanding of common automotive and new, latest mass manufacturing technologies and the relationship to design feasibility for a variety of processes including stamping, welding, injection molding, thermoforming, and lamination to achieve world-class craftsmanship/ performance targets. 
- Proficiency in 3D modeling utilizing CATIA V5 or V6 is essential within an automotive product development environment. Experience with Change Control and Part Release within 3DExperience platform is a bonus. 
- Strong working knowledge of DFM and DFA, including familiarity with GD&T and dimensional controls

Electrical safety inspections are at the core of OMS Prüfservice. As an
Electrician, you will inspect portable electrical equipment at customer
sites and help ensure it can be operated safely.

You will start your working day directly from home , and your working
time begins as soon as you travel to your first customer.

You will work at customer sites in the Potsdam and West Berlin area.

This means you will work in the field without overnight travel or shift
work, while building your career in the growing and future-oriented electrical safety inspection industry.

****

****

jobs.occupation: Are you a skilled dentist from abroad?  (m/w/d) (Zahnarzt/-ärztin)
jobs.description:
Start Your Dental Career in Germany

We will support you on your journey to becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

Have you graduated in dentistry outside Germany and dream of building your professional future here?

Are you looking for more than just a job? Do you want to become part of a friendly team that values you as a person and supports your professional development?

Then we would love to meet you.

About Us

We are a modern, family-owned dental practice located in the beautiful Northern Black Forest region of Germany.

Many of our patients have trusted us for years—often for generations. We know our patients personally, take time for them, and believe that excellent dentistry begins with trust and personal relationships.

We combine state-of-the-art technology with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Our practice offers:

- Digital dentistry
- CAD/CAM technology with same-day crowns
- High-quality prosthetic dentistry
- Modern diagnostics
- Professional preventive care
- A friendly and experienced team

We believe that exceptional quality requires time, dedication, and attention to every individual patient.

Your Career Path

We are looking for dentists from abroad who would like to complete their professional recognition and obtain their dental license in Germany.

You will begin working as a Dental Assistant while becoming familiar with the German healthcare system, our clinical procedures, and everyday practice.

During this time, we will actively support you throughout your recognition process until you achieve your goal of becoming a licensed dentist in Germany.

We already have experience successfully guiding an international dentist through this process and understand both the professional and personal challenges involved.

What We Offer

✔ Support during the professional recognition process

✔ A small and welcoming family-oriented team

✔ Modern equipment and digital workflows

✔ High-quality dentistry

✔ Excellent long-term career opportunities

✔ A respectful, supportive and appreciative working environment

An International Team

Moving to a new country can be challenging—but you won't be alone.

In our practice we speak:

🇩🇪 German

🇬🇧 English

Our team members also speak:

🇷🇺 Russian

🇺🇿 Uzbek

🇹🇷 Turkish

This multicultural environment helps many new colleagues feel comfortable from their very first day.

Live Where Others Spend Their Holidays

Our practice is located in one of Germany's most beautiful regions—the Northern Black Forest.

Here you'll enjoy:

- Beautiful forests and nature
- Excellent quality of life
- Safe and peaceful surroundings
- Easy access to Karlsruhe, Pforzheim and Stuttgart

Many international colleagues appreciate the relaxed lifestyle and welcoming community that our region offers.

Who We Are Looking For

You are a great fit if you:

- Graduated in Dentistry outside Germany
- Would like to build your future in Germany
- Minimum B1 German language level (better B2)
- Motivated to improve your German
- Enjoy working with people
- Are reliable, friendly and committed
- Appreciate teamwork and continuous learning

Let's Build Your Future Together

If you are looking for a practice that truly believes in your potential and wants to help you succeed, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Your journey to a successful dental career in Germany can begin here.

We look forward to getting to know you!
